subject: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Requirements for Redwood Pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T15:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Requirements for Redwood Pilot

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you set up for the pilot:  

Call recap:
- Pilot scope: 2 dedicated concurrency lanes for inference + observability.
- Timeline: target start of pilot week of 3/23.
- Technical owner: Natalie (will be looped in on onboarding).
- Commercial path: procurement needs clarity on PO vs card and invoice/process requirements.

Action items / Ask from Nimbus Health:
1) Procurement path: do you plan to submit a PO (preferred) or pay via corporate card?
2) Billing ops requirements: billing name, billing address, tax ID (EIN) and any required invoice fields (PO number, PO line item details, VAT specifics).
3) Net terms: confirm whether Net-30 is acceptable or if you require Net-45/60.
4) Marketplace interest: would you prefer a marketplace purchase (AWS/GCP marketplace) or direct invoicing to Redwood? Marketplace can simplify procurement for some customers but requires a different contract flow.

Attached: Redwood-Proposal-Preview.pdf (high-level order summary).

If you can share the preferred procurement flow and billing contact we’ll draft the commercial paperwork and W-9 and sample invoice for your AP team to validate. I’ve cc'd Aditya to help with commercial questions.

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@nimhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Billing Requirements for Redwood Pilot

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the helpful proposal. A few answers from procurement/finance:  

- Procurement path: We generally purchase via PO for most vendors. So PO preferred.
- Net terms: Net-30 is our standard and should be fine for a pilot (unless Redwood requires otherwise).
- Invoice requirements: Invoice must include our PO number, vendor legal name, and our billing address below. PDFs emailed to AP with the PO number in the subject line are our standard.

Billing name / address / tax:
Nimbus Health Inc.
Accounts Payable
1234 Clinical Way, Suite 200
Boston, MA 02115
EIN: 12-3456789
AP email for invoices: ap@nimhealth.com

VAT: Not applicable (US entity).

Marketplace: We prefer direct invoicing for now (marketplace introduces added procurement steps).

Please send your W-9 and a sample invoice layout showing where the PO number and line items will appear. Also confirm whether Redwood can accept and reference our PO number on the invoice and whether ACH/wire instructions will be sent with the invoice.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up with our AP lead if helpful.

Best,
Sofia Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager | Nimbus Health
sofia.patel@nimhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0234
